semantics: Owner-decided holds for a source refresh. A held record's flagged relationship is not applied to the changed source record: the compile leaves the current source usage (and its direct synonyms) out, applies no mapping to it and allocates nothing for it. The original approval, its historical Sporely ids and any supersession retirement stay as they are. A hold names one record; every other flag still stops preparation. A held relationship is a publication blocker until its impact is assessed. A hold may instead name a source_usage: when NorTaxa would rebind that usage to another Sporely id (registry alias conflict), the compile leaves the existing binding and does not rebind; any unlisted conflict still stops the compile.
